questions.q: Why could the Hamburg boats not help Mr. Fogg?
choices: They did not leave until the 14th
They went to Havre, not Liverpool or London
They were too slow to cross in time
They carried only heavy freight, not passengers
questions.evidence: the Hamburg boats did not go directly to Liverpool or London, but to Havre

questions.q: How did Passepartout feel after they missed the China?
choices: Crushed, blaming himself for ruining his master
Relieved that the long journey was finally over
Angry at Fix for making them miss the boat
Hopeful that a faster steamer would come along soon
questions.evidence: he overwhelmed himself with bitter self-accusations

questions.q: Mr. Fogg slept profoundly at the hotel while the others could not rest. What does this show about him?
choices: He had given up and no longer cared about the bet
He stayed calm even when things looked hopeless
He was ill and needed a great deal of sleep
He had secretly already booked another steamer

questions.q: Where was the Henrietta bound when Mr. Fogg found her?
choices: Liverpool
Bordeaux
Southampton
Havre
questions.evidence: I am setting out for Bordeaux, and shall go to Bordeaux.

questions.q: What did Captain Speedy think about carrying passengers?
choices: He liked them because they paid him well
He never had them because they were too much in the way
He took them only if they could help with the work
He carried them only on his trips to China
questions.evidence: Never have passengers. Too much in the way.

questions.q: "Up to this time money had smoothed away every obstacle. Now money failed." What is an obstacle?
choices: Something that blocks the way
A large sum of borrowed money
A friend who offers to help
A ticket for a long sea journey
questions.evidence: money had smoothed away every obstacle

questions.q: After the captain refused to go to Liverpool, what did Mr. Fogg do?
choices: Offered two thousand dollars each to go to Bordeaux
Went back to the hotel to wait for the Inman steamer
Hired a balloon to carry the whole party over the ocean
Hurried back to the hotel to tell Aouda the bet was lost

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: Fogg finding a ship to cross the Atlantic after missing the China
Fogg giving up the bet and settling down to live in New York
Fix arresting Fogg as soon as he reaches the New York hotel
Passepartout getting lost on Broadway and missing the ship at nine
questions.evidence: Will you carry me and three other persons to Liverpool?
